changelog: THE SACRED WOOD works properly now. The deer actually RUNS — it used to stand still until you walked into its line of sight, which rather undercut a hunt. It now breaks for cover the moment you're near, by sound rather than sight. The NIGHTWALKER no longer wanders: it marches on your HQ and wrecks whatever stands in its path. It also genuinely occupies a 2x2 — a real four-tile body sharing one health bar, with its art spread across the square, so it can't be squashed into a single tile by spawning in a corner. Hit any part of it and you hit the creature; bring the core down and the whole thing falls. The Spire's heart now uses the same system as a 3x3 and reads as one great heart instead of nine small ones. Also: beasts, forest gods, drones and civilians no longer get handed soldier names and ranks — no more 'Private The Nightwalker'.
